verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents stakeholder access to the platform and configurable vesting schedules for employees. A help article title also suggests admins can control whether shareholders see their equity value, which points to some stakeholder-facing view. The evidence never describes an employee portal showing grants, vesting progress or strike price, and waterfall modeling is described as a leadership tool, not an employee-facing what-if calculator. missing for 10: documented employee portal view of grants, vesting progress display, strike price display, employee-facing outcome/exit-value scenario modeling, independent corroboration of the employee experience.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes

citations.quote: manage ownership, equity transactions, compliance, documents, and stakeholder access in one place
configure vesting schedules for founders and employees
Advanced permissions give administrators control over who can view or modify sensitive equity data
